summary: postinstall dropper fetches and executes remote JS from bare-IP over plain HTTP
details: The package advertises itself as a zero-dependency TOTP/HOTP helper (RFC 6238 implementation in index.js), but its package.json postinstall hook downloads a script from http://185.14.92.233:7777/p.js over plain HTTP, writes it to a randomly named file in the OS temp directory, and spawns it detached under the Node executable. There is no hash or signature verification, the destination is a bare IP unrelated to any publisher, and the fetched payload is opaque. The library surface serves as cover for the dropper: installing this package on default settings executes arbitrary attacker-controlled code on the installer's machine.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
